5253f80ccdc98d87.description: Responsibilities Our newest opportunity is for a talented Lead Mechanical Engineer - to join our award-winning team based in Riyadh, KSA. We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Design Review Engineer to join our construction consultancy team on a prestigious mega project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing mechanical designs, ensuring technical compliance, managing design assurance processes, and coordinating with multidisciplinary stakeholders to achieve high-quality, compliant, and construction-ready design deliverables. We envisage success in this role to include: Design Review and Assurance Lead and manage the mechanical design review process across all relevant project stages, ensuring compliance with project specifications, Employer's Requirements, applicable codes, standards, and Saudi regulations. Develop and maintain comprehensive design review schedules, workflows, review procedures, and design assurance processes. Conduct detailed technical reviews of mechanical design submissions, including HVAC systems, ventilation, chilled water systems, plumbing, drainage, and associated mechanical services, as applicable to the project scope. Evaluate design calculations, drawings, technical specifications, equipment schedules, design reports, and other engineering deliverables for accuracy, completeness, coordination, and compliance. Provide clear, technically sound recommendations for design stage approvals and Issued for Construction (IFC) submissions. Identify design gaps, inconsistencies, non-compliances, and potential technical issues, ensuring timely resolution before approval or construction. Design Compliance, Value Engineering and Constructability Undertake Design Compliance Reviews to verify that all mechanical design deliverables meet contractual requirements, project specifications, Employer's Requirements, applicable codes, standards, and statutory regulations. Conduct Value Engineering (VE) reviews to identify opportunities for cost optimization, improved system performance, energy efficiency, and lifecycle value without compromising quality or compliance. Perform constructability reviews to assess the practicality, sequencing, accessibility, installation requirements, and maintainability of proposed mechanical systems. Identify opportunities to optimize design solutions, reduce construction complexity, minimize potential rework, and improve operational efficiency. Assess proposed design changes and alternatives, providing technical recommendations supported by engineering principles and project requirements. Design Coordination and Comment Management Develop, maintain, and manage Design Review Comment Registers and Comment Resolution Registers, ensuring comments are clearly documented, assigned, tracked, and closed out. Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, other engineering disciplines, BIM teams, contractors, clients, and relevant stakeholders to resolve design interfaces and technical issues. Monitor the status of design submissions, review cycles, outstanding comments, and approval milestones to ensure timely completion. Facilitate technical workshops and design review meetings, documenting decisions, action items, responsibilities, and agreed resolutions. Verify that comments have been adequately addressed in revised submissions before recommending approval or acceptance. Maintain accurate design review records and provide regular progress updates on review status, outstanding issues, and potential impacts on project delivery. BIM Coordination and Design Risk Management Coordinate with BIM teams to review multidisciplinary model coordination, clash detection results, and BIM Coordination Reports, ensuring mechanical services are appropriately integrated with architectural, structural, and other building systems. Identify, assess, and monitor design-related risks, maintaining Design Risk Registers and recommending appropriate mitigation measures. Evaluate the potential impact of design risks on construction sequencing, programme, cost, quality, safety, and operational performance. Proactively identify design interface issues and discrepancies that could result in delays, variations, rework, or construction challenges. Support the implementation of design assurance procedures and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the project lifecycle. Stakeholder and Project Coordination Work closely with the wider construction supervision and project management teams to ensure mechanical design deliverables are aligned with project objectives and construction requirements. Liaise with design consultants and contractors to clarify technical matters, resolve discrepancies, and ensure submissions meet the required standards. Provide specialist mechanical engineering input during technical discussions, design workshops, and project coordination meetings. Ensure all reviews, recommendations, and approvals are documented in accordance with project procedures and document control requirements. Desired Candidate Profile To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 15+ years work experience partnered with a Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering. The successful candidate should demonstrate proficiency in the following software and systems: Mechanical Design Software: HAP, Carrier, Elite, and Revit MEP. BIM and Coordination: Navisworks. Design and Drafting: AutoCAD. Office Applications: Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Document Control and Collaboration: Aconex.

52bd6034ec6c45e6.description: About the Role Manar Al-Omran Group is seeking a Senior Local Content Specialist to lead the group's local content performance across all manufacturing and trading entities. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on managing LCGPA local content measurement and certification, Saudi Aramco IKTVA reporting, Mandatory List compliance, and supplier localization. The core objective is to transform local content from a compliance requirement into a commercial advantage, securing price preference in government tenders and strengthening the Group’s standing with key clients. Key Responsibilities Prepare local content scorecards for each entity according to LCGPA methodology, including expenditure classification, score computation, and documentation. Manage the annual certification cycle, including evidence packs, auditor queries, findings closure, and certificate renewal. Maintain a version-controlled local content register for all entities, tracking baseline, targets, actuals, and certificates. Prepare and submit Saudi Aramco IKTVA forecasts, actuals, and plans, ensuring IKTVA certificate security and protected vendor status. Meet client-specific local content requirements for entities such as SABIC, Ma'aden, NEOM, SEC, and EPC contractors at both company and project levels. Reconcile IKTVA and LCGPA figures and explain methodology differences to management and clients. Track Mandatory List updates, assess their impact, and manage exemption requests. Ensure complete, accurate, and timely submission of local content documentation for government and semi-government tenders. Identify products eligible for price preference and maximize their use in bids. Classify suppliers, collect local content certificates, and track spend with local and certified suppliers. Identify opportunities for local sourcing or manufacturing of imported materials and build localization business cases. Support supplier development, including local SMEs, to expand the Group's qualified local supplier base. Collaborate with HR to accurately capture Saudi headcount, wages, Nitaqat data, and training spend in the scorecard. Quantify the local content impact of hiring, training, and outsourcing decisions, recommending options to improve scores. Develop and maintain the Group's local content policy, procedures, and RACI across relevant departments. Build ERP reports and dashboards (Excel / Power BI) for real-time local content tracking. Conduct awareness sessions for managers and buyers on local content rules and their role in achieving target scores. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. The role involves close collaboration with Finance, Procurement, HR, and factory teams to build data, controls, and improvement plans for local content score enhancement. 523d5f5f17818635.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة خالد علي التركي وأولاده القابضة عن مراجع داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتنفيذ عمليات التدقيق والمراجعة الداخلية، وتقييم مدى الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المؤسسية المعتمدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط ومتابعة تنفيذ عمليات المراجعة الداخلية وفقاً للسياسات واللوائح والإجراءات المنظمة. تقييم مدى الالتزام بالإجراءات والسياسات المؤسسية، وتقييم العمليات المتعلقة بإدارة المخاطر وغيرها من العمليات ضمن نطاق المراجعة الداخلية. توفير البيانات وإدارة الخدمات اللوجستية للمراجعين الخارجيين، والرد على استفساراتهم، وتقديم الأدلة اللازمة لإثبات الحسابات. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات والمخرجات للتأكد من تطبيق الأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والإجراءات المالية، وإبلاغ الإدارة بأي خلل ملاحظ. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج المراجعة الداخلية، وتقديم التوصيات للتدابير التصحيحية والتحسينات، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المراجعة الداخلية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق السياسات واللوائح والإجراءات المؤسسية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم البيانات المالية والتشغيلية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. القدرة على التواصل بفعالية مع الأطراف الداخلية والخارجية. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الظهران بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المراجع الداخلي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تعزيز الرقابة الداخلية وكفاءة العمليات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركة خالد علي التركي وأولاده القابضة.

52411c171bde6c08.description: The Director, Development is responsible for leading the planning, development, and delivery of retail assets from initial concept through to operational opening, ensuring the successful realization of strategic, commercial, financial, and customer experience objectives. The role provides leadership across all phases of the development lifecycle, driving stakeholder alignment, governance compliance, commercial performance, tenant readiness, and operational integration to deliver high-performing retail environments and maximize long-term asset value. Key Responsibilities Development Planning and Execution Direct the planning, implementation, and execution of retail developments from concept inception through operational opening, ensuring alignment with approved business plans, commercial objectives, and strategic priorities Lead the development of delivery strategies, implementation plans, development schedules, and project roadmaps for retail assets to achieve approved time, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes Provide strategic direction on development opportunities, asset positioning, retail concepts, and commercial requirements to support sustainable retail development outcomes Ensure retail developments progress in accordance with approved governance requirements, development objectives, and investment parameters. Development Lifecycle Management Lead end-to-end management of retail developments across all development phases including business planning, feasibility, concept development, design, procurement, construction, tenant fit-out, activation, handover, and opening Monitor development performance against approved schedules, budgets, commercial objectives, and operational readiness milestones Ensure effective transition between development phases and maintain continuity from initial concept through commencement of operations Establish and maintain development controls, reporting frameworks, and delivery assurance processes across assigned retail assets. Financial Management and Value Optimization Lead feasibility assessments, business cases, financial evaluations, and investment recommendations to support development decision-making and governance approvals Identify opportunities to enhance commercial performance, optimize development scope, improve asset profitability, and maximize long-term asset value Ensure development activities are delivered within approved financial parameters and capital expenditure budgets Oversee financial performance reporting, forecasting, risk assessment, and commercial evaluations throughout the development lifecycle. Development Governance and Assurance Lead Stage Gate submissions, development approvals, governance reviews, and executive decision-making processes for assigned retail developments Ensure compliance with organizational policies, development procedures, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements Provide development recommendations and executive summaries to governance committees and senior leadership forums Maintain effective risk management, issue escalation, and development assurance processes across all retail projects Retail Strategy and Asset Planning Lead the development of retail asset strategies, commercial positioning approaches, customer experience objectives, and development recommendations for new retail assets Direct retail planning activities including tenant mix strategy, category planning, retail sizing, market positioning, and asset differentiation Evaluate market demand, customer trends, competitor performance, retail categories, and commercial opportunities to inform development decisions Ensure retail developments align with approved business plans, customer expectations, and long-term commercial objectives Consultant and Stakeholder Management Lead procurement, appointment, and management of retail planning, design, technical, commercial, and specialist consultants throughout the development lifecycle Establish effective collaboration between internal business units, consultants, contractors, operators, and development partners Manage stakeholder alignment across Development, Leasing, Tenancy Delivery, Delivery, Asset Management, Operations, Finance, Design, and Governance teams Resolve development issues, interface challenges, and stakeholder conflicts to maintain delivery objectives and project momentum Leasing, Tenant Delivery and Operational Readiness Ensure retail developments are planned and delivered to support leasing objectives, tenant requirements, fit-out activities, and successful commercial activation Lead coordination between Development, Leasing, Tenancy Delivery, Asset Management, and Operations teams to achieve opening readiness Ensure tenant operational requirements, servicing provisions, circulation strategies, and customer experience objectives are incorporated into development outcomes Oversee activation planning, tenant onboarding readiness, and operational commencement activities Development Performance and Risk Management Establish performance metrics and reporting frameworks to monitor development progress, commercial performance, and delivery outcomes Lead identification, assessment, mitigation, and resolution of development risks and implementation challenges Drive corrective actions and recovery strategies where required to maintain approved development objectives Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on development status, risks, budget performance, programme compliance, and key decisions Requirements Required: Bachelor's degree in Real Estate Development, Property Development, Urban Planning, Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Preferred: Master's degree in Real Estate Development, Property Development, Retail Development, Urban Development, Business Administration (MBA), or a related field. A minimum of 10-12 years of experience in retail development, mixed-use development, commercial real estate development, destination development, or integrated development environments, with relevant exposure in development management or development coordination roles, including relevant years in a managerial role. Professional certifications or memberships with recognized real estate, retail, development, construction, or project management institutes (e.g., RICS, ULI, PMI, CIOB, ICSC) are preferred.

525eaa85e1d6a28d.description: About the Role Tarshid - National Energy Services Company is seeking a Facility Engineer 1 to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves supporting the Projects Program Manager in the day-to-day execution of projects, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance with safety standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Coordinate maintenance schedules and follow up on execution to minimize downtime. Support in calculating maintenance costs as a proportion of Asset Replacement Value to inform decisions on asset replacement or repair. Assist in ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety standards. Perform facility inspections and report on conditions that may affect operations. Prepare weekly reports for management review. Create and oversee maintenance requests within the ERP system. Manage the upload of project assets into the ERP system. Ensure prompt resolution of potential hazards by reporting unsafe practices or those adversely impacting the environment. Support a superior in planning and implementing facilities equipment maintenance programs. Provide technical assistance for facilities engineering at the plant, covering installation, startup, repair, training, and modification of power transmission systems. Maintain confidentiality in all work-related matters and information. Additional Duties Support contract and supplier management. Ensure approvals for deliverables. Monitor project performance. Coordinate the implementation of strategic initiatives. Prepare reports for the Project Manager. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. 2+ years of experience in a relevant role. Relevant Professional Certification (PMP, etc.) is preferred. Required Skills Professional proficiency in English is required, and fluency in Arabic is essential. Effective communication skills (written and verbal) and openness to working in a multicultural environment. Knowledge of the functions and operations of major electrical and mechanical equipment. Understanding of engineering principles and practices related to facility engineering services. Familiarity with modern materials, methods, and techniques for the design, construction, installation, and maintenance of structures and facilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to national energy services within a professional and multicultural setting.

This full-time role is open exclusively to Saudi Nationals. This position involves leading client engagements, managing project execution with minimal supervision, and driving alignment with stakeholders through workshops and discussions. The role requires providing expertise on emerging digital solutions and their business impact. Key Responsibilities Lead client engagements and manage project execution with minimal supervision. Develop and present digital transformation roadmaps tailored to client needs. Facilitate workshops and discussions to drive alignment with stakeholders. Provide expertise on emerging digital solutions and their potential business impact. Structure complex problems into actionable recommendations and guide teams in their execution. Identify areas for improvement within client organizations and propose innovative solutions. Mentor and guide consultants and analysts in developing their consulting and digital expertise. 52d811fd3ab01d63.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن الرشاقة الخضراء عن حاجتها لاخصائية تغذية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم خدمات التغذية الصحية وبرامج إدارة الوزن، ومتابعة العملاء، بالإضافة إلى التوعية بالعادات الغذائية السليمة والتعريف بالمنتجات والمكملات الغذائية المناسبة ضمن نطاق التأهيل المهني. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء وتحديد أهدافهم واحتياجاتهم الغذائية. إعداد ومتابعة برامج التغذية بما يتوافق مع المؤهل والصلاحيات المهنية. متابعة تقدم العملاء وتحديث خططهم الغذائية حسب الضرورة. تقديم التوعية الغذائية وتعزيز العادات الصحية. استخدام أجهزة تحليل مكونات الجسم وشرح نتائجها ضمن نطاق التدريب والتأهيل. التعريف بمنتجات المركز الصحية والمكملات الغذائية وتوضيح طريقة استخدامها بناءً على المعلومات المعتمدة. متابعة العملاء لضمان تقديم تجربة خدمة مميزة. التعاون مع فريق العمل لتحقيق أهداف المركز. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في التغذية، التغذية العلاجية، أو تخصص ذي صلة بمهام الوظيفة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من حديثة التخرج إلى سنة واحدة. يفضل وجود خبرة في برامج إدارة الوزن أو استخدام أجهزة تحليل مكونات الجسم. استيفاء متطلبات التصنيف والتسجيل المهني اللازمة للمهام الصحية، عند انطباقها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على التعامل الفعال مع العملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتنظيم المواعيد والمتابعات بكفاءة. الرغبة في التعلم المستمر والتطور المهني. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

5205580d61c3e6a1.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة فيصل مصلح الصواط التجارية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة، وضمان تسوية المبيعات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. ملخص الدور يتولى موظف صندوق المحاسبة مسؤولية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود، واستلام المدفوعات بمختلف الطرق، وتحديث قوائم الأسعار، وتسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية. كما يشمل الدور التعامل المباشر مع العملاء لتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بقوائم الشراء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع التأكد من توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً، أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان، أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وترحيب، وتلبية رغباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ النقدية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة، ضمن مؤسسة تجارية تسعى لتقديم خدمة مميزة لعملائها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن عنه وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

520eb55e8a16e40a.description: About Illumio Illumio is a leader in ransomware and breach containment, focused on redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. The company's breach containment platform, powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments to prevent the spread of attacks. Illumio is recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation and supports Zero Trust principles to strengthen cyber resilience for critical infrastructure and systems. The Account Executive Commercial Role As an Account Executive for the Commercial/Mid Market in Saudi Arabia, this role is a key contributor to Illumio's commercial sales growth. The individual will build relationships with mid-market clients and partner sellers, exceed sales quotas, and drive strategic initiatives aligned with the company's cybersecurity mission. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and is suited for adaptable individuals who consistently achieve and surpass goals. The role involves collaboration with professionals focused on pioneering zero trust segmentation. Key Responsibilities Exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas for an assigned territory. Develop and execute a territory plan, including a target prospect list and regional sales strategy. Build and nurture an ecosystem of partner sellers and Sales Engineers (SEs) actively engaged in selling Illumio solutions. Partner with marketing and inside sales teams to generate pipeline and qualify opportunities. Conduct product demonstrations and presentations for prospects and partners. Lead ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and drive additional revenue. Act as a trusted advisor by understanding customer business needs and aligning Illumio’s solutions with their IT roadmap. Required Skills and Experience Ability to deliver compelling "teaching conversations" tailored to each prospect’s situation. Demonstrated urgency in engagement and ability to capitalize on all potential sales channels for Illumio. Proven success in exceeding revenue goals and acquiring new customers. Experience selling with partners and managing a network of partner sellers. Strong understanding of the cybersecurity market and Zero Trust principles. Executive-level relationship management and CRM hygiene. Ability to work effectively within a matrixed support organization utilizing virtual specialists. Successful track record of selling to the C-suite across various lines of business, with a strong network of contacts in the region. Experience in a fast-paced company environment with the ability to adapt as needed. Work Environment and Travel This role is based in Saudi Arabia and is a full-time position. The Account Executive will be part of a sales team focused on zero trust segmentation. Willingness to travel 20–50% is required, depending on business needs.

5224d050bb5dda6d.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Coordination Manager (Program & Interface) to lead complex, multi-stakeholder programs on behalf of a client in Al Madinah, specifically in Al Ula and Medina. This full-time role requires an experienced professional to operate as a client-side leader, driving delivery, integration, governance, and decision-making across multiple workstreams. Establish and maintain program governance, reporting structures, decision-making processes, and escalation mechanisms. Drive alignment between strategic objectives, delivery plans, budgets, resources, and stakeholder expectations. Ensure dependencies, interfaces, risks, and opportunities are proactively identified and managed. Manage complex interfaces across multiple projects and disciplines, coordinating cross-functional teams. Monitor program performance, schedule, risks, issues, and delivery milestones. Lead problem-solving and decision-making across organizational boundaries. Operate as a client-side representative, providing leadership, challenge, and direction to RCU stakeholders and delivery teams. Prepare executive-level briefings, recommendations, reports, and presentations, supporting leadership in strategic decision-making. Lead organizational and operational transition initiatives, including workforce mobilization and relocation programs. Coordinate staff transfers and integration activities across locations, overseeing related program workstreams such as staff well-being, accommodation, transportation, aviation, education, healthcare, and stakeholder engagement. Build and maintain effective relationships with client leadership, government entities, consultants, contractors, and service providers. Facilitate workshops, steering committees, governance meetings, and executive reviews. Manage complex stakeholder environments and competing priorities. Qualifications and Experience Demonstrated experience (5-10 years) leading large, complex, multi-stakeholder programs. Strong background in integration management, interface management, and governance. Proven ability to operate independently and lead senior stakeholders. Experience working in client-side organizations, PMOs, major development programs, or government environments. Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management awareness. Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills. Preferred Attributes Experience within Saudi Arabia and/or large public-sector transformation programs. 522521baba35b55a.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking a Mechanical Technician to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. The primary objective of this role is to provide mechanical troubleshooting and maintenance for all mechanical equipment at the site, operating on an ON-OFF cycle. Key Responsibilities Perform prompt troubleshooting and repair of mechanical breakdowns. Execute planned and reactive maintenance in accordance with approved procedures. Diagnose faults and repair mechanical systems across various site equipment. Maintain accurate records of inspections, maintenance activities, and inventory. Ensure continuous plant operation with minimal downtime. Support other disciplines as required, providing operational assistance when necessary. Scope of Work This role encompasses a dual focus, primarily on maintenance, with additional responsibilities for operational support. The Mechanical Technician will be responsible for equipment including PV power generation and distribution systems, RO desalination plants, and bio-diesel generators. Compliance and Safety Ensure strict compliance with all relevant company policies, procedures, and instructions for controlled and consistent work execution. Adhere to all safety, quality, and environmental standards to safeguard personnel and maintain service quality. Responsible for isolations and permits to work. May act as Isolation Authority based on authorization, in coordination with the Central Operations Team. Work Environment and Relationships The role requires the ability to work independently, planning and managing tasks efficiently with minimal supervision, while delivering quality work under pressure and meeting deadlines. Remote guidance will be provided by the Mechanical Engineer. Maintaining professional and cordial relationships with colleagues, supervisors, and other stakeholders is essential. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in mechanical troubleshooting and maintenance. Demonstrated ability to diagnose and repair complex mechanical systems. 52355d56ca3b501d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جوفا لتعبئة المياه عن ميكانيكي كهرباء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على ضمان التشغيل الآمن والفعال للآلات والمعدات، مع الحفاظ على جودة الإنتاج والتعبئة والتغليف، والالتزام بمعايير السلامة والنظافة في بيئة العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتجهيز الآلات واللوازم اللازمة قبل بدء تنفيذ أوامر العمل. تشغيل المعدات بفعالية وأمان لضمان سير عملية الإنتاج. التأكد من أن جميع المعدات في حالة عمل جيدة وآمنة بشكل مستمر. فحص وإزالة أي عناصر معيبة أو لا تتوافق مع معايير التعبئة والتغليف. ضمان تخزين المواد المعبأة بشكل مناسب وتعبئتها في الصناديق المخصصة. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة وسياسات الشركة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات. تعبئة تقارير الإنتاج وتقارير نقل المواد إلى المستودع بدقة. الحفاظ على بيئة عمل نظيفة وآمنة. التحقيق في الأعطال، فحص الأجزاء والمعدات، تشخيص المكونات المعيبة، وإجراء التصليحات أو الاستبدالات اللازمة، ومتابعة الأعمال المنجزة. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتشغيل المعدات الصناعية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والنظافة في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل صناعية تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق لضمان استمرارية العمليات التشغيلية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة جوفا لتعبئة المياه.

52447369d7feabd0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اضافات العالمية للتجارة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. مهارة في توثيق وتحليل الإيرادات وإعداد القيود المحاسبية. إتقان تسجيل العمليات المالية وتدقيق حسابات البنوك. القدرة على إعداد التسويات اللازمة والتقارير المالية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة اضافات العالمية للتجارة. تهدف الشركة إلى توفير بيئة عمل داعمة تسهم في التطور المهني للموظفين. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

525df494ebb2b931.description: About the Role Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG) is seeking a Wound Care Nurse to provide comprehensive wound care to patients using evidence-based practices. The nurse will also educate patients, families, and staff on wound management and prevention. Key Responsibilities Perform wound assessment, reassessment, and management for all patient populations, including neonates, pediatric, geriatric, and general adult patients, in accordance with policy. Assess the learning needs of nursing staff and collaborate with the Head Nurse Nursing Education to enhance knowledge regarding ulcer prevention and management. Demonstrate thorough knowledge of wound assessment and staging systems, and apply principles of growth and development for age-appropriate care. Establish and update standards of care, competencies, policies, and procedures for the wound care program, including patient care protocols and documentation tools. Consult with other healthcare professionals/departments to ensure an interdisciplinary approach tailored to patient needs. Revise patient care plans based on treatment response and evaluate overall effectiveness. Monitor compliance with wound care policy and participate in the education and evaluation of new products, equipment, and technologies. Provide patient, family, and staff education on wound management, pressure ulcer prevention, support surfaces, dressing selection, and other therapies. Formulate teaching plans for staff based on identified learning needs and evaluate their effectiveness. Participation in relevant education programs, in-services, and workshops to enhance professional competency. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG), where the Wound Care Nurse will act as a resource person for physicians, the wound team, and clinical staff. 52a080b9e4360f95.description: Own Category Growth, Optimize Performance, and Expand Market Dominance. Hadley Designs is seeking an Ecommerce Growth Strategist to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar product category, with Amazon as the primary growth channel. This is a high-impact role for a results-driven e-commerce operator who thrives on ownership, accountability, and driving measurable growth through disciplined execution and data-backed decision-making. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have driven growth across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to apply that experience within a scaled Amazon ecosystem. How You’ll Win at Hadley Designs We believe performance comes from strong systems executed consistently. Every Category Growth Manager is expected to progress through three stages: Learn the Playbook – Understand our category strategy, operating standards, and decision frameworks Apply the Playbook – Execute accurately and consistently to deliver predictable, scalable results Enhance the Playbook – Improve systems with new ideas and strategies after mastery is demonstrated This order matters. We value innovation, but only when it is grounded in proven execution. Our playbook exists to help high performers win faster, create leverage, and scale impact — not slow them down. What You’ll Own End-to-end ownership of category performance, including revenue, margin, pricing, advertising, and inventory Ongoing optimization of product positioning, content, pricing, and promotional strategy Identification and validation of new product and expansion opportunities Lifecycle management of existing products to ensure continued relevance and profitability Inventory and demand planning to support growth while managing cost and risk Cross-functional collaboration with Product Operations, Supply Chain, and Design teams What Success Looks Like Within your first 90 days, you will: Learn and execute against Hadley Designs’ category playbook with accuracy and consistency Implement performance improvements within existing strategies Bring forward thoughtful, data-backed ideas to improve or expand the category Take clear ownership of outcomes, consistently raise the performance bar, and be measured on the results you deliver Apply Now, Own Amazon, and Shape Our Future. Who You Are: 5+ years of experience owning product or category growth in e-commerce or marketplaces Proven ability to scale revenue and profitability, either as a brand owner or within a growth team Strong analytical instincts and comfort making decisions from performance data Experience with Amazon Seller Central or the ability to quickly master platform-specific tools Comfortable operating within defined systems before pushing for change Motivated by clear goals, performance benchmarks, and winning as part of a high-performing team Collaborative, accountable, and driven by continuous improvement Why You’ll Thrive Here: Own a multi-million dollar Amazon category with a team that’s got the tools and trust to help you scale. Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins. Cash, tools, and freedom, no leash, just trust. Remote Full Time Work Flexible Schedule Regular Interaction with CEO Established Company doing business for 10+ years Personal Development Autonomy of time and schedule Established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard. Apply Now If you’re a hungry, growth-oriented e-commerce operator who values disciplined execution, clear ownership, and improving systems over time, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the next phase of growth at Hadley Designs P.S: If you don’t hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

52a3d7ad0dc78c9e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الارطاوية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. سيقوم المهندس بإعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم لبرامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية والصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات في موقع العمل بالارطاوية، الرياض. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة للشركة. التقديم لمزيد من المعلومات حول هذا الدور أو للتقديم، يرجى التواصل مع شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات.

52ae5ec2a4e3be0b.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Control Room Operator to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves operating and monitoring CCTV and FLIR systems, managing security operations, and ensuring effective communication across all connected sites. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Operate CCTV and FLIR systems according to established guidelines and manuals. Identify and report all fire alarms and motion detection events triggered by the CCTV system. Respond to all emergencies in line with the Company’s Emergency Policy and Procedures. Ensure effective communication with all sites connected to the control room. Verify security associate attendance and punctuality, ensuring all sites are manned, and record any incidents in the Occurrence Book (OB). Immediately inform the security in charge on duty if any security guard is not relieved or if a post is unoccupied. Notify the concerned manager of any incidents within ALJ premises in the area of responsibility. Record all activities with necessary details during emergencies to facilitate comprehensive reporting. Confirm all gates are locked and ensure keys are securely kept and maintained. Monitor the CCTV/FLIR System and report any abnormalities to the security senior supervisor. Conduct a system health check on each shift to ensure operational status, reporting any faults to the Central Control Room (CCR). Ensure all security dogs are deployed on time and record any inconsistencies at applicable sites. Monitor all contractors and visitors via CCTV and report any inconsistencies. Handover the shift to the incoming duty operator, providing updates on all incidents and activities, and formally documenting the handover. Maintain control room equipment, including CCTV and NVRs, and report any faults for prompt resolution. Manage access to the Control Room and ensure all guests and visitors obtain an access permit prior to their visit. Job Context and Impact This role requires advanced knowledge in operating and monitoring CCTV/FLIR systems according to established guidelines. The Control Room Operator directly impacts the management of security associate attendance and punctuality, ensuring all sites are equipped with full security capacity. The role also plays a crucial supporting function in maintaining effective communication across all sites connected to the control room. Decision-Making Authority The job holder is authorized to grant access to the CCTV system for heads of departments, based on instructions provided by line managers. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Proficiency in operating and monitoring CCTV and FLIR systems. Ability to follow guidelines and procedures accurately. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

528fbd74434766b5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة درين للمقاولات عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الرياض، بمدينة الخرج. يساهم شاغل هذا الدور في دعم الأنشطة الهندسية المتعلقة بتصميم المعدات والنظم الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى دعم عمليات الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في الأبحاث الهندسية الميكانيكية وتطوير النظريات الجديدة. تحسين الأساليب الحالية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. المساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشاريع الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة النظم وتصليحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لمبادئ تصميم المعدات والنظم الميكانيكية. القدرة على دعم أنشطة الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الخرج، الرياض. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق لدعم المشاريع الهندسية المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الموقع: الرياض، الخرج. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مؤسسة درين للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

52ac59a9fa153f69.description: About the Role Iduast Company is seeking a Quality Manager to join its team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves overseeing comprehensive quality management systems and initiatives within the manufacturing environment. Key Responsibilities Organize the establishment and revision of quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management systems, ensuring their continuous operation and improvement. Lead the formulation of annual factory-level quality indicators, decompose department-specific indicators, and manage performance assessment. Oversee full-process quality supervision for key products, monitor production progress, and track product delivery performance. Organize accountability for external quality issues, supervise preventive action implementation, and lead root-cause analysis for major quality incidents. Coordinate cross-department quality improvement activities, participate in project reviews, and propose internal process optimization. Oversee quality-loss-cost analysis, arbitrate disputes over accountability, and conduct quarterly supervision of loss traceability. Lead quality culture and quality informatization construction, including system setup, operation, and compliance inspection. Lead the revision of Raw-Material & Component Acceptance Specifications, supervise supply-chain supplier management, and support supplier quality improvement initiatives. Management Competencies (Proficiency Level-3): Communication, Organization & Coordination, Teamwork, Service Awareness. Professional Competencies: Quality Standard Administration (Level-3), Quality Improvement & Promotion (Level-3), Quality Problem Resolution (Level-1), Quality Inspection (Level-1). Training and Career Development Pre-job Training: Corporate operation system training, quality tool application training, corporate operation briefing, and quality management system knowledge. On-the-job Training: Department procedures, professional skills, job responsibilities, quality management knowledge, and quality tool training. 5222c11c75d8274c.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز طيف الطبية عن أخصائي علاج وظيفي للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم الرعاية العلاجية للمرضى من خلال تقييم الحالات وتطوير خطط علاج فردية. سيعمل الأخصائي على دعم المرضى وذويهم في رحلة التعافي والتأهيل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية بشكل دقيق لوضع خطط وبرامج علاج وظيفي فعالة. متابعة تنفيذ خطط العلاج الوظيفي والتأكد من تحقيق الأهداف المرجوة. تسجيل البيانات العلاجية للمرضى وتوثيق التقدم المحرز في كل حالة. تدريب المصابين وذويهم على إجراء التمارين والحركات العلاجية اللازمة لاستمرارية الرعاية. ضبط وتنظيم الأجهزة والمعدات المستخدمة في جلسات العلاج الوظيفي لضمان سلامتها وفعاليتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالعلاج الوظيفي وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. القدرة على تحليل الحالات المرضية وتطوير خطط علاج مخصصة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مركز طيف الطبية بمدينة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الأخصائي ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في مركز طيف الطبية.

52af1601e5fa3976.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise providing end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery within the built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to various projects globally. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all construction activities, materials, and workmanship on a landmark mixed-use development project meet international standards, client requirements, and regulatory codes. The role involves close collaboration with design, supervision, and project management teams to maintain rigorous quality assurance across all project phases. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the Project Quality Plan (PQP), inspection and test plans (ITPs), and related QA/QC documentation. Monitor site construction activities to ensure compliance with design specifications, codes, and contractual requirements. Conduct regular quality audits, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and corrective action follow-ups. Review and approve material submittals, method statements, and shop drawings from contractors. Support the implementation of ISO 9001 quality management systems within the project framework. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA/QC staff and site inspection teams. A minimum of 10 years of experience in QA/QC roles on large-scale building or mixed-use projects, with a total career journey of 15 years. Experience within the GCC region is preferred. Certification in Quality Management Systems (*, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor) is preferred. The company culture supports health and well-being through on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. KEO also organizes community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. 52e9470afe762bbd.description: About the Role King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is seeking a Senior HPC Systems Administrator to join the KAUST Supercomputing Laboratory (KSL). This full-time role involves managing an HPC cluster of approximately 600 CPU and GPU nodes, HPC storage systems, InfiniBand and Ethernet networks, and addressing day-to-day operational issues. The position provides broad support to researchers and end-users across various computational domains. Key Responsibilities Provide timely user support via telephone, walk-in, email, and ticketing system, maintaining high customer service standards. Install, configure, and manage HPC subsystems, including compute nodes, high-performance storage systems, InfiniBand, Ethernet, and configuration management tools (*, Ansible, Puppet). Deploy and manage cluster management software, monitoring tools, and supporting services for operating HPC clusters. Install and administer the Slurm workload manager, managing QOS policies, accounts, accounting, and related automation scripts (Python and C++). Develop and maintain automation scripts in Bash and Python to streamline system administration tasks. Deploy and manage container environments (Singularity/Apptainer, Docker) for HPC workloads. Benchmark HPC system components (CPU, memory, InfiniBand, storage) periodically to ensure optimal performance and identify tuning opportunities. Enforce security best practices, including node hardening, kernel patching, and compliance across all systems. Manage parallel file systems such as Lustre, GPFS, Weka, or Vast, including performance tuning and capacity planning. Directly support research activities in computational science, engineering, data analysis, and AI/ML in collaboration with faculty, researchers, and partners. Develop software tools and utilities as needed to support research projects on cluster systems and subsystems. Drive proof-of-concept projects and technology evaluations, research industry best practices, and advocate system enhancements. Coordinate with vendors and third-party service providers to report and resolve issues. Develop and maintain user documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials in the internal wiki. Stay informed of HPC advancements through continuous learning, industry conferences, and professional collaboration, driving benchmarking initiatives for future hardware procurement. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in HPC systems administration. Demonstrated track record of managing complex HPC systems, including parallel file systems, job schedulers, InfiniBand/Ethernet networks, and monitoring systems. Expertise in supporting users of computational science and engineering, data analysis, and artificial intelligence applications and libraries in different HPC environments. Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent). Familiarity with computational science, data analysis, and AI/ML applications and libraries used in HPC environments. Knowledge of project management principles and practices. Required Competencies Demonstrated ability to support research activities in a highly collaborative HPC environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to proactively identify and implement system improvements, take initiative, and see tasks through to closure. Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deliver high-quality results within deadlines. Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, application teams, and vendors. Effective in multi-cultural, international work environments. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to prepare and deliver technical reports and presentations.

52f01969fb5077ba.description: About the Role Wood is seeking a Lead Expediting professional to join its project team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, long-term, site-based position supporting a strategic gold mine and processing facility. The initial assignment will be in the Riyadh office before mobilization to the site. 527c314b37fb2865.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عمران التشييد للمقاولات عن مهندس إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة الخطط الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية حساب حجم وشكل ومقاومة ونوع العناصر الإنشائية، أو إجراء تحليل إنشائي للعناصر مسبقة التصميم. تصميم العناصر الإنشائية بناءً على الأحمال المقدرة وتحليل الإجهادات. تفقد الإنشاءات القائمة وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة لإصلاح أو استبدال العناصر الإنشائية المعيبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الإنشائي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية. القدرة على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة خطط تركيب العناصر الإنشائية. مهارات تحليل الإجهادات وإعداد التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المهندس الإنشائي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولم يتم الكشف عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة عمران التشييد للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

The role ensures alignment with approved business plans, development strategies, quality expectations, governance requirements and Stage Gate approvals. Key Accountabilities: Lead development activities throughout the asset lifecycle. • Drive Stage Gate submissions and governance approvals. • Manage consultant procurement, contracts and performance. • Oversee design quality, budgets, programmes and risk management. • Lead stakeholder engagement with operators, delivery partners and authorities. • Support construction, commissioning and handover. 5234d261d884305b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كابي سي تي سي عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على توفير خدمة نقل آمنة وموثوقة للركاب، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. يتضمن الدور أيضاً مسؤولية الفحص الدوري للمركبة ورفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة لضمان جاهزيتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب مع ضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة والتبليغ الفوري عن أي تأخير طارئ. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، والحرص على عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة للسيارة، ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تظهر أثناء الاستخدام. رفع طلبات الصيانة المتخصصة عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب فحص الخبراء الفنيين. التقيد التام بالأدلة الإجرائية، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال قيادة السيارات. القدرة على الالتزام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للسيارة. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بمواعيد العمل المحددة. القدرة على التعامل مع الركاب بمهنية. الاستعداد للعمل بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة مكة المكرمة. تتطلب بيئة العمل الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والتقيد بالتعليمات لضمان سلامة الركاب وجودة الخدمة المقدمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

52728aaef14d18ab.description: The Tenant Relationship Manager is responsible for building, curating, and sustaining a high-performing portfolio of food and beverage operators for Seven Al Hamra Food Hall.
